logic.injury_admission: F_ApplyResult tests outcome bit0x10; SM_SetInjureState at 0x3c5d84 enforces the positive 3000ms Character+0x14fc gate and selects the Injury state/clip. port/level-world/tests/player_injury_same_fsm_v7.cpp proves the registered FSM11 End event 0x22 routes to Idle3 after the source empty CSInjured::OnEvent at 0x3c0044.
logic.death_admission: SM_SetDeadState at 0x3c58c8 selects ordinary Died field+0x1c into machine+0x28 before Dead state12 focus. CSDead::OnUpdate at 0x3c004c is empty. Source-state method evidence is in port/level-world/reference/character-state/NOTES.md and character-state-methods/NOTES.md.
logic.animator_close: AnimatorSet completion at 0x3672c8 / AnimatorBlender completion at 0x366628 sets pending completion, and Applicator CheckCallback at 0x36440c later calls the installed callback. CharAnimator::__Callback at 0x3c90ec only marks the pending flag; actual state/sequence completion is handled in its later update. Source scheduler notification mapping and existing close behavior are recorded in reports/original-actor-animation-events.json.
logic.implementation: RetainedSequenceServices.seeded_closed is now the finite seeded leaf close seam. RetainedSequencePlayback invokes it only after a genuine final completion when no configured source repeat remains, and sets its one-shot latch before calling the borrowed callback. CombatSession binds it to numeric animation event0x22. Existing full advance closed/finished behavior is unchanged. ActorCombatRuntime still releases Injured at source current_ended and holds Died; End34 dispatch uses the same actor's registered source state consumer.

evidence.expected: A finite admitted Injured leaf emits one numeric End34 at its authored completion and does not invoke the Dead state's physical-removal behavior. A finite Died leaf emits one numeric End34 only at its authored completion; the Dead state's registered handler may then remove its physical body. HP reaching zero selects Died but is not itself a completion event. Completion does not replay during terminal updates or save restore. Source loops/repeats do not emit a finite-close End34 per intermediate cycle.
uncertainties: No original gameplay clip/timestamps prove the reported actor's visible animation continuity or all version behavior.

The source Dead handler's SetPhysicalObject body and the complete registered FSM/state service are external to this test. The fixture observes the same-actor numeric/state-event dispatch and verifies that Injury does not route through the Dead handler; it does not fake a physical body or the FSM11->Idle3 registration. That source registration is independently proven by player_injury_same_fsm_v7.cpp.
Available source assets are recovered v1.0.2; matching the reported v1.0.3 gameplay remains unverified.
